schema_xai_tts_text_normalization_desc: Convert numbers, abbreviations, and symbols into more natural spoken forms before synthesis.
schema_xai_realtime_language_desc: Optional language hint for xAI speech transcription, such as en or de.
schema_xai_realtime_prefix_padding_desc: Amount of audio retained before xAI detects speech, in milliseconds.
schema_xai_realtime_silence_duration_des: Silence xAI waits before ending a spoken turn, in milliseconds.
model_settings_system_instruction_descri: Replace the administrator-configured system instruction for this conversation.
model_settings_system_instruction_placeh: Leave empty to use the administrator-configured system instruction.
